title: The Nearness of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The nearness of God means that the high and holy Lord draws near to the humble, broken, repentant, and seeking. God is not distant from His people, but graciously present with them.
summary: The nearness of God means that the high and holy Lord draws near to the humble, broken, repentant, and seeking. God is not distant from His people, but graciously present with them.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is God drawing near in human flesh. Through Him, sinners are brought near to God, and believers have access to the Father by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is exalted above creation, yet He is not far from His people. Scripture reveals the Lord who dwells in the high and holy place and also with the contrite and lowly in spirit.

God’s nearness is especially precious to the brokenhearted. He is near to those who are crushed in spirit. Suffering, weakness, repentance, and humility do not push God away when people come to Him by faith.

This nearness does not make God casual or common. The near God remains holy. He draws near in grace so people may be revived, restored, forgiven, strengthened, and taught to walk with Him.

In Christ, nearness becomes saving access. Those who were far off are brought near through His blood. The Gospel does not merely tell people that God exists; it brings them near to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people feel spiritually abandoned, especially in grief, disability, shame, depression, recovery, or church hurt. The nearness of God speaks comfort without pretending pain is small.

This doctrine also invites repentance. God calls people to draw near to Him, cleanse their hands, purify their hearts, and humble themselves before Him. Nearness is grace, not permission to remain careless.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Draw near to God through Christ. Bring Him your grief, weakness, confession, and need. Do not measure His nearness only by emotion. Trust His promise, seek Him in prayer and Scripture, and walk humbly before Him.
